paite: Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante ahong paikhiak uh; akha thumna, huai ni mah in Sinai gamdai ahong tung uhi.
heading: Israelte Sinai Tang Ah

paite: Rephidim a pan pawtkhia in, Sinai gamdai ahong tung ua, gamdai ah agiak uhi. Huai ah Israelte'n tang mazawn ah puanin akai uhi.
Pathian kiang ah Mosi ahohtou a, TOUPA'N tang a pan amah asam a, "Hichibang in Jakob inkote kiang ah na chi dia, Israel suante na hilh ding hi:
Aiguptate tung a ka hih leh muvanlai khate a ka hon tuah a, keimah kiang ngei ka hon tutdan na muta uhi.
Huaiziak in tu in, ka aw na man taktak ua, ka thukhun na zuih taktak uleh, leitung pumpi kei a ahih ziak in mite sang in kei a ding in gou manpha na hi ding uhi.
Kei a ding in siampute, lalgam leh nam siangthou na hi ding uhi. Hiai thute Israel suante kiang a na gen ding ahi,” achi hi.
Mosi ahong a mite upate asamsak a, TOUPA'N amah apiak hiai thu tengteng ama uah aluita hi.
Mi tengteng in kituaktak in adawng ua, "TOUPA thugen tengteng ka hih ding uh," achi uhi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA kiang ah atun nawn hi.

TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, na kiang ah meipi sah in ka hong, na kiang a thu ka gen chiang a mite'n azak theih ua, chik lai peuh a nang ahon gintak theihna ding un,” achi hi. Mosi in mite thu TOUPA ahilh hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mite kiang ah va hoh inla, tuni leh zingchiang a ding in amaute siangsak in, apuante uh sawpsiang uhen.
Ani thum ni a ding in mansa in om uhen. Ani thum ni a mi tengteng mitmuh a Sinai Tang tung a TOUPA ahong paisuk ding ziak in.
Mite kimvel ah dai na kai ding a, tang a hohtou lou ding in pilvang un, ahihkeileh tang kim khoih lou ding in pilvang un. Kuapeuh tang khoih sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.

Khut in alawng ding uh ahi kei, alawng peuhmah suang a denlup ngeingei ahi ding; ahihkeileh thal a kap pailet ahi ding. Ganta hiam mihing hiam hileh leng, ahing kei ding. Pengkul sawtpi agin chiang in, tang ah ahong paitou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
Tang a pan mite kiang ah Mosi apaisuk a, apuante uh asawp uhi.
Ama'n mite kiang ah, "Ni thum ni a ding in kisakhol un; na zite uh naih kei un," achi hi.
Ani thum ni in zingsang in hichi ahong hi a, vanpigingte leh khophiate, tang tung a meipi sah, pengkul aw angaih a ngaih ahong ging a, giahphual sung a om mi tengteng alingta uhi.
Mosi in puanin a pan mite Pathian toh kimu ding in ahon pikhia a; amau tang nuailam ah adingh uhi.
Meikuang a tang tung a kipan TOUPA ahong kumsuk ziak in Sinai Tang apumkhut vekta hi. Haltuina meikhu bang in atungkah a, atang pumpi aling zungzung hi.
Sawtpi pengkul ging angaih semsem lai in Mosi in thu agen a, Pathian in aw in amah adawng hi.
Sinai Tang tung a tang vum tung ah TOUPA ahong paisuk hi. Atang vum tung ah TOUPA'N Mosi asamtou a, Mosi ahohtou hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Paisuk inla, mite vauhilh in. En ding in TOUPA lam hong phuvang in alak ua tampi amangthang kha ding uhi.”
"TOUPA kiang a hong pai siampute leng kihihsiangthou uhen, huchi lou in zaw atung uah TOUPA apuakzak kha ding," achi hi.
Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Sinai Tang ah mite ahong paitou thei kei ding uh. Tang kimvel in dai kai inla, hihsiangthou in chi a na hon hilh ziak in," achi hi.

TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Paisuk inla, huan Aaron toh hong paitou un. Himahleh siampute leh mite'n TOUPA kiang a hong ding in hon phuvang kei uhen. Huchi lou in zaw amaute tung ah apuakzak kha ding,” achi hi.
Mite kiang ah Mosi ahohsuk a, akiang uah thu agenta hi.
